creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, 2026-10-07: "right now for panes, we generate this like flex ID ... with P prefixed. In reality, you know, you launch a pane, you launch your agent, now your agent has that name. It can be hard to reference them ... it's not a very human-friendly kind of approach." Agreed the same day:

- **One identity per pane, two spellings.** The id (`p29te12q4t`) stays the permanent address: unique across machines, minted before the pane exists, never reused, what logs and scripts hold. Every pane also gets a short name that people and agents use.
- **No separate agent id.** What persists is the pane; Muster resumes an agent into the same pane, and messaging already addresses an agent by its pane.
- **Generated by default**: one word from a curated list of a few hundred short, distinct nouns (`otter`, `maple`, `cobalt`), chosen so no two share their first three letters, which makes completion pleasant. Not adjective-noun pairs (twice as long for uniqueness live panes do not need), not `claude-3` (wrong once the program changes, and the numbers churn).
- **Renamed** by `pane new --name` and `pane rename`, and following the harness's session name as the label does today. A name can be anything; generated ones are plain words.
- **Accepted wherever an id is**: `--pane`, `msg post --to`, `pane wait`, `tab focus`; resolved among live panes when used; `otter@devenv` when two machines both have one, the form msg already uses for participants. Today `--name` sets only a display label and msg needs a separate `join --name`; unifying them is most of the win.
- **Shown** in `muster window`, the agent list and banners, and carried in the pane's environment beside `$MUSTER_PANE`.
- **Reused** once its pane closes; the message log stores the id and shows the name the pane had then.

Comes before the sub-agents card (a_2die894mw): an agent naming the panes it makes is the first thing that design leans on.
title: 🏷️ Every pane gets a short, typeable name that works wherever its id does
